posts.title: Spreadsheet to calculate Dutch income tax and related stuff
posts.description: As you might know, I like to understand how things work. posts.title: First impression: Milk-v Duo Linux board
posts.description: For a project (building a low-power LoRaWAN gateway to be solar powered) I am looking at simple and low-power linux boards. One board that I came across is the Milk-V Duo, which looks very promising.
